q1.sampleAnswer: My name’s Wang Lei. I’m fourteen years old. I live in Chengdu, in the south-west of China. I live with my parents and my little sister. I find maths the easiest subject at school, because I’m good with numbers and I like solving problems. I usually listen to pop music, and sometimes I listen to rock music when I do sport. I like dogs best, because they’re friendly and clever. I don’t really like shopping, because it takes a long time and the shops are often crowded. I take photos almost every day with my phone, because I like keeping memories of my friends and the places I visit. I like funny films and action films, especially at the weekend with my family. I usually meet my friends in the park near our school, because we can play basketball there. Yes, I enjoy playing games on my phone, but my parents only let me play for half an hour a day.

互动交流：能回应对方、提出和回应建议与观点，推动讨论并努力达成一致
整体表现：能用 B1 水平的语言有效完成交流任务

q1.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题都用完整句子作答，并补充理由或细节（because…, usually…, especially…），能用一般现在时、频率副词和 like/enjoy doing 等结构，语言自然流畅。

q2.sampleAnswer: In this photograph I can see six teenagers in a park. They’re sitting on a blue blanket on the grass, and behind them there are a lot of tall trees. It looks like a sunny day, maybe in spring. On the left, a girl in a pink jacket is using a laptop. Next to her, a boy is looking at a tablet. In the middle, a girl is reading a book or maybe a magazine, and another girl is playing the guitar. On the right, a boy in a blue shirt is talking to her. I think they are friends and they’re having a good time together after school. Maybe they’re doing a project, or perhaps they’re just relaxing and listening to music.

q2.explanationZh: 好的描述要说清人物在做什么、穿什么、在哪里，以及其他物品和天气，用 on the left / in the middle / next to 等方位词组织，并用 I think / maybe / perhaps 合理推测；不会的词可以换种说法，持续说满约一分钟。

q3.sampleAnswer: Yes, I agree. An English class is useful, because the teacher can help him. Listening to songs is fun, but I don’t think he can learn very quickly that way. You’re right, studying alone with a book is a bit boring, and he can’t practise speaking. Watching films is good for listening, and an app is useful because he can use it anywhere, for example on the bus. I think the app is more useful than films, because it’s quicker. Yes, a private teacher is a great idea, because he can speak a lot and the teacher can correct him. But it’s quite expensive. In my opinion, the private teacher is the best, because he only has a short time before his holiday. So shall we choose the private teacher? Great, we agree.

q3.explanationZh: 好的回答能回应搭档的每个观点（同意/不同意并说明理由），比较不同方法的优缺点，用 I think / In my opinion / What about…? / Shall we…? 等推动讨论，最后与搭档一起选出最好的方法。

q4.sampleAnswer: Yes, I enjoy learning English, because I can watch films and talk to people from other countries. I listen to English songs almost every day on the way to school, because they help me learn new words. My mum speaks a little English, because she uses it at work, but my grandparents don’t speak it at all. In the future I’d like to learn Japanese, because I love Japanese cartoons and I want to visit Japan. I think learning to speak is more important, because when you travel you need to talk to people. But writing is important too, for example for exams and emails.

q4.explanationZh: 好的回答对每个问题表明观点并给出理由或具体例子，能用 would like to 谈将来的愿望，用 because / but / for example 展开，必要时回应 What do you think? 等追问。
